record: First full fine-tuning run on lwd_v1 and independent evaluation

run.settings: SGD lr=1e-3 momentum=0.9 weight_decay=5e-4, constant lr, feature_weight=1, kl_weight=2.5e-6, float16 AMP, batch 4, 10 epochs (50000 steps)
run.note: evaluations/*/metrics.json reports checkpoint_epoch=4: the checkpoint stores a 0-based epoch index; it is epoch 5 in summary.json and history.csv.

best_vs_last_on_val.method: test_vae.py --splits val on best.pt (epoch 5) and last.pt (epoch 10); per-sample bias = mean(pred - true); debiased RMSE removes each sample's bias
best_vs_last_on_val.interpretation: Epoch-to-epoch validation RMSE swings are mostly a nearly uniform offset that drifts under constant-lr SGD. The last checkpoint has better structure (debiased RMSE 0.0120 < 0.0137) but a -0.017 log10 global offset, so selection by raw RMSE is partly selecting on offset noise.

pixels_with_error_above_half_delta.note: Largest counts are weak samples with delta about 0.05 whose global offset (0.01-0.02) approaches delta/2; strong samples have isolated flipped pixels (up to about 30 per sample) at fault/pinchout tips and image edges.

ood_contrast.interpretation: Beyond the training contrast range (max 1.5 decades) the decoder compresses contrast by 3-6% and one pinchout sample shows texture artifacts inside the wedge.

slope_definition: per-sample least-squares slope of (pred - mean pred) on (true - mean true); 1 means full contrast recovery
follow_up_options: Decay the learning rate (e.g. cosine to about 1e-5) or keep an EMA of weights so the global offset settles; the structure is still improving at epoch 10.
Widen the training contrast range only if real formations exceed 1.5 decades between adjacent units.
